title: refactor: remove list quickFilters mechanism (ADR-0053 phase 3a)
body:
Part of **ADR-0053** (list-view navigation — two mutually-exclusive modes). Retires one of the five overlapping list-nav mechanisms.

## What
The standalone list-view `quickFilters` (chip row) only duplicated `userFilters` `tabs`. Removed completely:
- **types**: `NamedListView.quickFilters`, `ListViewSchema.quickFilters`, the `QuickFilterItem` / `ObjectUIQuickFilterItem` / `SpecQuickFilterItem` types + index re-exports
- **zod**: `quickFilters` schema
- **@object-ui/core**: deleted `utils/normalize-quick-filter.ts` (+ export)
- **plugin-view** `ObjectView`: dropped the quickFilters pass-through
- **plugin-list** `ListView`: removed state, memo, filter-merge, deps, toggle handler, the chip render row, and the empty-state condition
- **react** spec-bridge: dropped the `quickFilters` input field, import, and normalization mapping
- **tests** updated (plugin-list ListView, react SpecBridge/P1SpecBridge)

## Not touched
`plugin-gantt`'s own `quickFilters` (`QuickFilterDef` on `GanttConfigEx`, the per-field dropdown row above the chart) is **independent** of list-view nav and stays as-is.

## Verification
- Full monorepo `type-check` passes (58/58).
- Affected tests green (195).
- (The one `react-hooks/rules-of-hooks` lint error in `ListView.tsx:295` is pre-existing — a deliberate try/catch `useObjectLabel` wrapper — unrelated to this change.)

Follow-ups (ADR-0053): suppress `renderNamedViewTabs` in app-shell context; fold `viewDef.tabs` → `userFilters.tabs`; shared `ListNavBar`; Zod `refine` + `check` guardrails; rewrite fixtures.
